message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick note you can save somewhere handy (e.g., in a notes app, calendar, or sticky‑note): --- **Reminder – 27 March 2024** *Check and renew your Netflix subscription.* --- **How to set a reminder:** | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **iOS / iPadOS** | 1. Open the **Reminders** app.
2. Tap “+ New Reminder”.
3. Enter “Renew Netflix subscription”.
4. Tap the info icon (i), set the date to **27 March 2024**, and choose a time.
5. Toggle “Remind me on a day” and “Remind me at a time”. | | **Android** | 1. Open the **Google Calendar** app.
2. Tap the “+” button → “Event”.
3. Title: “Renew Netflix subscription”.
4. Set date to **27 March 2024** and time.
5. Under “Add notification”, choose “At time of event” or “10 min before”. | | **Windows** | 1. Open **Microsoft To‑Do** or **Calendar**.
2. Create a new task/event titled “Renew Netflix subscription”.
3. Set due date to **27 March 2024** and add a reminder. | | **Mac** | 1. Open **Calendar**.
2. Double‑click on 27 March → “New Event”.
3. Title: “Renew Netflix subscription”.
4. Set time and click “Add Alert” → “At time of event” or “10 min before”. | If you prefer a quick text reminder, you could also set a phone alarm or use a voice assistant (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) with a command like: - “Hey Siri, remind me to renew my Netflix subscription on March 27th.” - “Hey Google, remind me to renew Netflix on March 27th.” That should keep you on track! Let me know if you’d like help setting it up on a specific device.
